text: Squat. Keep your whole foot grounded. Sit your hips back and bend your knees in a comfortable range. Breathe out as you stand.
Chair sit-to-stand. Place a sturdy, non-wheeled chair against a wall. Sit down gently, then press through your whole feet to stand.
Shallow squat. Stand near a wall for balance. Bend your knees and hips a little, then stand tall. Keep the movement comfortable.
Pause squat. Lower in control. Pause briefly at a comfortable depth, then stand. Keep breathing.
Slow-lowering squat. Take three seconds to lower, then stand smoothly. Keep your whole foot on the floor.
Kneeling push-up. Knees on the mat, hands just wider than shoulders. Keep a steady line from head to knees. Lower your chest, then press away.
Wall push-up. Hands on a wall at chest height. Keep your body straight as you bend your elbows and bring your chest toward the wall. Press back.
Full push-up. Hands just wider than shoulders. Keep your trunk steady from head to heels. Lower with elbows angled back, then press up.
Push-up with a pause. Use your comfortable push-up position. Pause briefly near the bottom, then press away. Stop before your form breaks.
Glute bridge. Lie on your back, knees bent and feet grounded. Squeeze your glutes to lift your hips without arching your back. Lower slowly.
Glute bridge with hold. Lift your hips using your glutes. Hold briefly with ribs relaxed, then lower gently. Keep your pelvis level.
Bridge march. Lift into a low bridge. Keep your pelvis level while lifting one foot a little, then set it down and change sides.
Prone W raise. Lie face down, forehead comfortably supported. Bend elbows into a W. Gently lift the arms without shrugging or lifting your head.
W raise with hold. Face down with arms in a W. Gently lift, pause briefly, then lower. Keep the neck relaxed.
Supported shoulder-blade squeeze. Lie face down with arms supported in a W. Gently draw shoulder blades toward each other without lifting your head.
Reverse snow angel. Lie face down. Sweep your arms slowly from near your hips toward overhead, only through comfortable shoulder range. Keep neck neutral.
Dead bug. Lie on your back, knees bent above hips. Slowly reach one arm and the opposite leg away. Return and change sides. Keep your lower back steady.
Alternating heel slide. Lie on your back with both feet supported. Slide one heel away, then return and change legs. Keep your trunk still.
Supine heel tap. Lie on your back with knees bent above hips. Lower one heel toward the mat, return, then change legs. Avoid arching your back.
Standing calf raise. Hold a wall or sturdy chair lightly. Rise onto your forefeet, then lower slowly. Keep your weight balanced.
Slow calf raise. Rise onto your forefeet, then take three seconds to lower. Hold stable support for balance.
Supported split squat; left. Left foot forward, right foot back. Hold a wall or a sturdy chair placed against a wall. Bend both knees to lower vertically, then stand.
Supported split squat; right. Right foot forward, left foot back. Hold a wall or a sturdy chair placed against a wall. Bend both knees to lower vertically, then stand.
Supported split squat; change halfway. Use a fixed staggered stance with wall or chair support. Lower gently and rise. Switch the front leg halfway through.
Alternating reverse lunge. Step one foot back and lower comfortably. Push through your front foot to return. Alternate evenly; use support if needed.
Shallow lateral lunge. Step to one side, bend that knee and send hips back. Return to the centre and change sides. Keep the range comfortable.
Side step with shallow squat. Take a small side step, bend knees gently, then stand and move back. Change direction evenly.
Standing hip hinge. Soften your knees. Send hips backwards while keeping a long neutral spine. Squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
Staggered hip hinge; change halfway. Place one foot a little behind the other. Hinge your hips back with a long spine. Switch the front foot halfway.
Side plank; left. Left elbow under shoulder, knees bent. Lift hips gently and keep a steady line from shoulders to knees. Breathe.
Side plank; right. Right elbow under shoulder, knees bent. Lift hips gently and keep a steady line from shoulders to knees. Breathe.
Straight-leg side plank; left. Left elbow under shoulder, legs extended. Lift hips and hold a steady line. Keep breathing.
Straight-leg side plank; right. Right elbow under shoulder, legs extended. Lift hips and hold a steady line. Keep breathing.
Bird dog. On hands and knees, reach opposite arm and leg away. Keep your hips level. Return slowly and change sides.
Bird dog; one limb at a time. On hands and knees, reach one arm or one leg away at a time. Keep your hips still. Change sides evenly.
Bird dog with hold. Reach opposite arm and leg away. Hold briefly without rotating your hips, then return and switch sides.
Kneeling forearm plank. Elbows under shoulders, knees on the mat. Hold your trunk steady and breathe normally. Rest before form breaks.
Forearm plank. Elbows under shoulders, legs extended. Keep a steady line from head to heels without sagging. Breathe.
Kneeling shoulder tap. Hands under shoulders, knees on the mat. Lift one hand to the opposite shoulder, replace it, then alternate without rocking.
Kneeling weight shift. Hands and knees on the mat. Gently shift weight from one hand to the other while both hands stay down. Keep your trunk still.
Brisk march. March on the spot with relaxed shoulders and comfortable arm swing. Keep a pace where you can still speak.
Opposite-hand knee march. March with each hand moving toward the opposite knee. Stay tall and move in a comfortable rhythm.
March with arm drive. March steadily and swing opposite arms with purpose. Keep your shoulders relaxed and steps controlled.
Low-impact step jack. Step one foot out as your arms rise comfortably. Return and alternate feet. Keep one foot on the floor.
Alternating knee drive. Stand tall and lift one knee comfortably. Lower and change legs. Use a wall or chair for balance if needed.
Side step with reach. Step sideways, bring the other foot in and reach comfortably. Change direction. Keep steps soft.
Double side step. Take two small steps to one side, then two back. Stay upright and add an easy arm reach if comfortable.
Straight-punch shadow boxing. Use light straight punches with relaxed shoulders. Keep elbows soft at the end of each punch. No weights.
Light uppercut shadow boxing. With elbows bent, make small upward punches in front of you. Keep shoulders relaxed and avoid forceful twisting.
Heel dig with arm swing. Place one heel lightly in front, bring it back, then alternate. Add a relaxed arm swing.
Heel dig with reach. Alternate heel digs in front as your arms reach comfortably upward. Keep shoulders relaxed and arms below painful range.
Side-to-side toe tap. Tap one toe lightly to the side, bring it back, then alternate. Keep your weight centred.
Standing hamstring curl. Bend one knee to bring your heel back toward your buttock. Lower and alternate; keep knees near each other.
Forward-and-back march. Take small marching steps forward and back in clear space. Stay balanced and face the same direction.
Easy march. March gently on the spot. Relax your shoulders and let your breathing settle.
Shoulder circles and arm swings. Roll your shoulders gently and swing your arms through a comfortable range. Avoid forcing any movement.
Ankle rocks. Hold stable support. Gently shift weight from heels toward forefeet and back, keeping the movement small.
Gentle arm reaches. Reach one arm, then the other, comfortably upward and forward. Keep your ribs relaxed.
Supported calf stretch; left. Left leg behind with heel grounded, front knee slightly bent. Hold a wall. Feel a mild stretch; never force it.
Supported calf stretch; right. Right leg behind with heel grounded, front knee slightly bent. Hold a wall. Feel a mild stretch; never force it.
Standing breathing and shoulder release. Stand comfortably. Breathe slowly and let your shoulders soften. Make small gentle shoulder movements.
Comfortable chest opening. Stand tall with arms low. Gently draw shoulders back to open the chest without arching. Breathe naturally.
